title: Gitex Global
metaDescription: Gitex Global: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Tech Events.

overview.about: GITEX Global in Dubai is one of the largest technology exhibitions in the world, filling the Dubai World Trade Centre with launches, startups and enterprise tech from across the globe. It is the Middle East's flagship tech gathering and a magnet for AI, cloud and hardware announcements.
overview.nextEvent: The next GITEX Global is held at the Dubai World Trade Centre, bringing together thousands of exhibitors and tens of thousands of visitors. It spans enterprise IT, AI, cybersecurity and a large startup programme (Expand North Star).
